Gotama (N. of Kuśri, Uddālaka, Aruṇa, ŚBr.; of Śaradvat, Hariv.; Mṛcch. v, 30; VP.; of Śatānanda, L.; of Śākya-muni; of Nodhas and Vāma-deva, RAnukr.; of a teacher of ritual, Lāṭy.; ĀśvŚr.; ĀśvGṛ.; of a grammarian, TPrāt.; Lāṭy. (= got˚) N. of the first pupil of the last Jina (one of the three Kevalins)
N. of a Nāga (also ˚maka), Divyāv. ii
gautama m. pl. Gautama's family, Hariv. 1788; Pravar.
gautama m. a kind of poison, L.
gautama n. N. of several Sāmans, ĀrṣBr.; Lāṭy. iv, 6, 16
a: gautamaḥ N. of(1) the sage Bhāradvāja; (2) of Śatānanda, Gotama's son; (3) N. of Kṛpa, Droṇa's brother-in-law; (4) of Buddha; (5) of the propounder of the Nyāya system of philosophy. Comp. — saṃbhavā the river Godāvarī.
